messages.snippet: Daniel, Rebecca, Draft completion funds flow attached for the 4 December completion. Sources: £21.4m
messages.subject: Project Harbor - draft funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Rebecca,

Draft completion funds flow attached for the 4 December completion. Sources: £21.4m equity from Fund IV, £18m senior facility from Clydesford, balance from Bidco cash. Uses: £34.11m to the Sellers' solicitors, £3.79m into escrow, repayment of £1.45m existing bank debt, plus fees and SDLT. Sources and uses tie to nil. Please confirm the facility drawdown mechanics, Rebecca.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - draft funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Funds flow agreed from our side. CPs are satisfied subject to receipt of the certified board minutes and the executed security. We'll fund the £18m to your client account on the morning of 4 December against your drawdown notice.

Rebecca Stourton
Clydesford Bank plc
